say:1:1311004001:1.text: That is the undead flame. However, there is but a single flame present here... Odd, there ought to be a pair of flames together.
say:1:1311004001:1.source_cn: 就是它了，亡灵之焰。不过这里只有一盏……奇怪，应该两盏...

say:2:1311004002:1.text: Did someone steal it? Or did it secretly run away? Chippy has heard that some will-o'-wisps like wandering around...
say:2:1311004002:1.source_cn: 会不会被别人拿走了？或者……它自己偷偷跑掉了！满满听说...

say:3:1311004003:1.text: This type of flame does not typically wander off on its own, and there appear to be no human tracks in the vicinity.
say:3:1311004003:1.source_cn: 这种注魔的亡灵火焰可不会自己乱飘的，这附近也没有人类足迹。

choice_prompt:4:1311004003.text: This type of flame does not typically wander off on its own, and there appear to be no human tracks in the vicinity.
choice_prompt:4:1311004003.source_cn: 这种注魔的亡灵火焰可不会自己乱飘的，这附近也没有人类足迹。

say:5:1311004004:1.text: This entire region was once the property of Carolina's family. She may have placed a second undead flame in another part of the estate.
say:5:1311004004:1.source_cn: 嗯，这片区域曾经都是卡列琳娜家族的领地，或许她将另一盏...

say:6:1311004005:1.text: All of this used to belong to her family?! Wow, she must've had a very comfortable life.
say:6:1311004005:1.source_cn: 全都是她的家族领地！哇，那她的生活一定很优渥舒适。

say:8:1311004008:1.text: Let us venture further into the valley to the east.
say:8:1311004008:1.source_cn: 我们可以去东边的山谷深处再找找看。

say:9:1311004009:1.text: That region was once Carolina's family garden, and further along, there is a clearing that served as a small hunting ground, which, naturally, was also a part of her property.
say:9:1311004009:1.source_cn: 那一带曾是卡列琳娜家的花园，再往深处是一个小型猎场，当...

say:10:1311004010:1.text: What kind of person is she?
say:10:1311004010:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡，卡列琳娜是个怎样的人？

say:11:1311004011:1.text: ... When I perished in battle, Carolina had not yet been born. When we crossed paths inadvertently, she had already transformed into a Graveborn.
say:11:1311004011:1.source_cn: ……我战死的时候，卡列琳娜还远未出生。我和她偶然相识的...

say:12:1311004012:1.text: I was surprised when I saw her. She was a noblewoman, unassuming and tranquil as a peaceful lake... What cause had the God of Death to bestow the Graveborn curse upon her?
say:12:1311004012:1.source_cn: 见到她的时候，我很惊讶。她是一位贵族少女，湖泊般谦逊又...

say:13:1311004013:1.text: How did she become a Graveborn?
say:13:1311004013:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜她……是怎么成为亡灵的？

say:14:1311004014:1.text: All I know is that her family maintained a deep connection to the temple. If we wish to gain entry into Whiteridge Temple, she may possess the means to help us.
say:14:1311004014:1.source_cn: 我只知道她的家族与圣堂私交甚密，如果想要进入白山大教堂...

say:15:1311004015:1.text: As to how she became a Graveborn, she never disclosed it to me, nor did I inquire, and indeed, I had no desire to ask...
say:15:1311004015:1.source_cn: 至于她为何成为亡灵，她没有告诉过我，我没有问，也不想问。

say:16:1311004016:1.text: Back to the task at hand. Let us be off.

say:18:1311004007:1.text: There are a few puzzling marks in the area... They appear to have been left at the main manor. But these were not created by humans, and they do not seem to be the tracks of animals.
say:18:1311004007:1.source_cn: 周围有一些奇怪的痕迹……嗯，似乎最后离开了主宅。但不是...
